Name: Jezaniah, Son of Hoshaiah
Summary: Jezaniah, son of Hoshaiah, was a captain of the remnant who came with Johanan to ask Jeremiah to pray for them and learn God's will about staying or going. He is a different man from Jezaniah the Maachathite.
KeyStory: Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah came with all the captains to Jeremiah, asking him to pray that the Lord would show them the way to walk and the thing to do.
RelatedPeople: Johanan, Son of Kareah; Jeremiah; Azariah, Son of Hoshaiah
LifeLesson: Coming to ask God's will is good — but only if you will do it when it contradicts your plan.
